## Bundle Trend Baseline
- ID: `bundle-trend-baseline`
- Kind: bundle-size
- Owner: Frontend QA
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: Tracked logical assets fail on gzip growth over 5% or 10,240 bytes, and new tracked assets over 10,240 gzip bytes block until reviewed.
- CI gate: `npm run bundle:report`
- Verify: `npm run bundle:report`
- Refresh: `npm run bundle:baseline`
- Review rule: Run after npm run build, inspect dist/reports/bundle-report.md, then commit tests/bundle-baseline.json.

## Generated Client OpenAPI Snapshot
- ID: `client-openapi-snapshot`
- Kind: api-contract
- Owner: LSAT integration
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: The typed client snapshot must not lag behind the live LSAT backend OpenAPI surface.
- CI gate: `npm run contract:check:client`
- Verify: `npm run contract:check:client`
- Refresh: `npm run gen:api`
- Review rule: Regenerate after backend contract changes and review both the JSON snapshot and generated TypeScript diff.

## Direct Sidecar Fetch Inventory Baseline
- ID: `direct-sidecar-fetch-inventory`
- Kind: ratchet-inventory
- Owner: Frontend architecture
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: New direct localhost:8100 fetch callers outside approved adapters fail until routed through an adapter or explicitly baselined.
- CI gate: `npm run check:sidecar-fetches`
- Verify: `npm run check:sidecar-fetches`
- Refresh: `node scripts/check-direct-sidecar-fetches.mjs --inventory-only --json`
- Review rule: Prefer removing resolved entries; only add new entries after deferring an adapter migration intentionally.

## LSAT Backend OpenAPI Baseline
- ID: `lsat-openapi-baseline`
- Kind: api-contract
- Owner: LSAT backend
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: Removed paths, methods, or 2xx response fields are treated as breaking contract drift.
- CI gate: `node scripts/export-lsat-openapi.mjs --check`
- Verify: `node scripts/export-lsat-openapi.mjs --check`
- Refresh: `node scripts/export-lsat-openapi.mjs --write`
- Review rule: Refresh only after backend route changes and generated client updates are reviewed together.

## LSAT Typed Route Schema Baseline
- ID: `lsat-typed-route-schema-baseline`
- Kind: api-contract
- Owner: LSAT backend
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: Host-consumed typed routes may add fields, but may not silently drop fields promised by the baseline.
- CI gate: `python -m pytest tests/test_openapi_contract.py -q`
- Verify: `python -m pytest tests/test_openapi_contract.py -q`
- Refresh: `UPDATE_SCHEMA_BASELINE=1 python -m pytest tests/test_openapi_contract.py -q`
- Working directory: `services/lsat-backend`
- Review rule: Refresh only with the backend contract and host generated-client diff.

## Prompt Regression Fixture
- ID: `prompt-regression-fixture`
- Kind: prompt-golden
- Owner: AI quality
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: Prompt hashes and required substrings must match the committed host and backend prompt fixture.
- CI gate: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/prompt-regression-fixture-floor.mjs`
- Verify: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/prompt-regression-fixture-floor.mjs`
- Refresh: `python -m app.prompt_contracts --dump`
- Review rule: Refresh host and backend prompt cases in one fixture change; run the host and backend prompt floor checks before committing.

## RAG Retrieval Fixtures
- ID: `rag-retrieval-fixtures`
- Kind: retrieval-golden
- Owner: RAG quality
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: Recall, precision, MRR, and nDCG must stay at or above the seeded fixture floor.
- CI gate: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/rag-eval.mjs`
- Verify: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/rag-eval.mjs`
- Refresh: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/rag-eval.mjs`
- Review rule: Hand-edit corpus and relevance judgments, then reseed floors only with a documented retrieval tradeoff or improvement.

## Route Performance Baseline
- ID: `route-performance-baseline`
- Kind: runtime-performance
- Owner: Frontend QA
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: Cold and warm route metrics must stay within the committed navigation/FCP/LCP/CLS/TBT budgets.
- CI gate: `npm run perf:regression`
- Verify: `npm run perf:regression`
- Refresh: `UPDATE_PERF_BASELINES=1 npm run perf:regression`
- Review rule: Refresh only after stable CI evidence and keep dist/reports/perf-regression.json with the review notes.

## Source Grounded Answer Fixture
- ID: `source-grounded-answer-fixture`
- Kind: grounding-golden
- Owner: AI quality
- Storage: committed
- Failure mode: Grounded CFA and LSAT answers must cite entailed chunks, and unsupported cross-domain answers must be rejected.
- CI gate: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/source-grounded-answer-eval.mjs`
- Verify: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/source-grounded-answer-eval.mjs`
- Refresh: `node --import ./scripts/register-ts-loader.mjs scripts/source-grounded-answer-eval.mjs`
- Review rule: Hand-edit fixture cases and chunks together; keep unsupported negative cases in the same fixture.

## Visual Regression PNG Baselines
- ID: `visual-regression-baselines`
- Kind: visual-png
- Owner: Frontend QA
- Storage: approved-ci-cache
- Failure mode: Missing route/theme/viewport PNG baselines fail closed inside visual regression unless update mode is explicit.
- CI gate: `npm run visual:regression`
- Verify: `npm run visual:regression`
- Refresh: `UPDATE_VISUAL_BASELINES=1 npm run visual:regression`
- Review rule: Review dist/reports/visual screenshots and diffs before approving the Linux baseline cache refresh.
